phase.goal: Determine whether FEAT-NOTIFY-CHECK can implement Day-slice-only execute=true defaulting, and stop on contract mismatch if the current repo lacks a Day-owned Notify-check intake/default/dispatch surface.

wave.goal: Bind existing Day runtime-indicator files, verify whether a Day-owned Notify-check intake/default/dispatch surface exists, and stop with a contract-mismatch verdict if absent.

verification.command: rg -n --hidden -S "notify check|notify-check|notifyCheck|notify_check|execute=true|execute false" frontend/app frontend/components frontend/lib frontend/e2e

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact Day runtime-indicator bindings are recorded.
The worker records whether Day Notify-check intake/default/dispatch bindings exist.
If no bindings exist, the packet records contract-mismatch-no-day-notify-surface and does not edit frontend behavior.
Runtime-indicator-only evidence is not misclassified as Notify-check acceptance proof.

deferred_work.item: Creating a new Day Notify-check frontend surface
Implementing execute=true defaulting after a concrete surface is approved
Adding Day Notify-check Playwright tests after a concrete surface exists
